title: Vertical editor tour on an accent field with whip moves
summary: A desktop editor is shown in a 9:16 frame as a dark window band on a saturated accent field; the camera never rests, pushing into panels, whipping between features with motion blur, then a typed brand line and URL close on black.
use_when: A desktop or web tool needs a vertical promo for short-form social feeds
The product flow is a sequence of clicks: browse, pick, edit, prompt, export
Silent autoplay: the UI and typed copy carry the message without VO
A real screen capture or a rebuilt UI is available for 6-10 surfaces

look.type_style: product UI type only (small grotesk, sentence case); prompt text medium grotesk ~2.5 % H; end line medium grotesk, sentence case, ~3.5 % H, white on black

sfx.event: cursor click on a button or send
option chip selected in the export dialog
hard cut to the black end card

params.brand: any brand.json: accent fills the field above and below the window band, bg is the dark UI, fg the end-card text
params.content.surfaces: 8-10 UI surfaces in tour order (gallery, detail, canvas, properties, picker, prompt, result, share, export)
params.content.rollWords: 6 one-word categories for the rolling column in the reveal
params.content.close: end line naming the product, 3 words
params.content.url: domain typed on the end card
params.content.result: a short clip or still shown as the generated output
params.timing.whipFrames: frames of each blurred whip (default 8-16 at 30 fps)
params.aspect: 9:16 (designed for it); the window band sits at 25-75 % of the height

notes: Silent reference: no music, no VO, cut_on_beat 0/2 hard cuts (no beats). SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. Only 2 hard cuts; 8 soft transitions are motion-blurred whips or zoom-blurs between UI surfaces, and long shots are split at state changes where transition_out names the camera move that carries across (no cut). The accent field fills the frame above and below a horizontal dark UI band for 3.30-47.53 s. Motion timings read at 0.25 s resolution; overshoot not measurable. Proposed term: accent-field band (not in vocabulary).
